title: First-Class Hover and Selection Mechanism
description: Dissolve hover and selection out of per-app commands/config into one first-class framework mechanism: unified InteractionDefinition per domain (granularities, hierarchy provider, HoverSpec, SelectionSpec) declared in the manifest alongside actions/utilities/tools/commands; new 🕹️interaction framework module holding the pure state machine (merge modes, range, transitive closure, validate_state) with Rust+TS parity and schema leaves; persisted-local selection via a new store HistoryLane mechanism that default undo/redo skips; ephemeral hover; uniform presence broadcast of selection/hover for every app via a typed PresenceInteraction field (wire bit 7) on PresencePeer; framework interception of interaction verbs in VcsArtifactApp replacing all per-app set-selection/set-hover handlers; UiTree/Tree/Shell/surface integration; migration of all ~14 apps plus the OS infinite module and fixtures.
